source_excerpt: BJP holds nationwide protests against Congress president’s 'derogatory' remarks on PM Modi’s late father left BJP workers stage a protest in front of the Congress office against controversial remarks made by Congress national president Mallikarjun Kharge, in Bhubaneswar. ANI ANI https://th-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/pej4sx/article71628688.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/20261026567L.jpg ANI Bhubaneswar, Oct 26 (ANI): BJP workers stage a protest in front of the Congress office against controversial remarks made by Congress National President Mallikarjun Kharge, in Bhubaneswar on Monday. (ANI Photo) BJP leaders and workers protested near Sena Bhawan Circle and on Rajaji Marg, close to Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge’s residence, in Delhi NEW DELHI The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Monday (October 26, 2026) staged nationwide protests against what it described as “derogatory” remarks made by Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge regarding Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s late father. Mallikarjun Kharge loses cool after heckler interrupts speech, says ‘Modi ka baap bhi jaayega’ shorts 1 BJP protests Kharge’s remark on PM’s father in Bihar and Jharkhand BJP protests Kharge’s remark on PM’s father in Bihar and Jharkhand Party leaders stage marches in Patna and Ranchi; burn effigies of Congress president BJP protests Kharge’s remark on PM’s father in Bihar and Jharkhand storyline 1 BJP workers held demonstrations in Delhi, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Karnataka, West Bengal, Telangana, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Kerala, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand, Rajasthan, and Chhattisgarh, demanding a public apology from the Congress leadership. In Delhi, BJP leaders and workers protested near Sena Bhawan Circle and on Rajaji Marg, close to Mr. Kharge’s residence. State BJP president and Union Minister of State Harsh Malhotra, along with other party leaders, participated in the protest. In Bihar’s Patna, party workers took out a “Jan Akrosh March” under the leadership of State BJP chief Sanjay Saraogi. BJP slams Kharge over ‘indecent’ remarks on PM Modi BJP slams Kharge over ‘indecent’ remarks on PM Modi Party says it would hold nationwide protests on October 26, 2026 against the “inappropriate and offensive remarks”. BJP slams Kharge over ‘indecent’ remarks on PM Modi storyline 1 In Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak demanded an apology from the Congress leadership over the remarks. In Jammu & Kashmir, workers of the Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha also expressed their outrage, while a “dharna” was held at Freedom Park in Bengaluru. In Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, a demonstration was organised under the leadership of State BJP president Rajeev Chandrasekhar. Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami and Union Minister of State Arjun Ram Meghwal also voiced their objections.
